title: Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) Premium Refund Terms
content:
# Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) — Premium Refund Terms

Premium accounting for Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) returns premium that was paid for coverage the policy no longer provides. The terms below apply on every coverage tier.

| Coverage tier | Premiums paid for coverage after the cancellation date | Premiums paid for months after the month of death | Smallest overpaid premium refunded rather than credited forward | Interest on premium refunds |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VGLI $50,000 Coverage | refunded | refunded to the estate | $1.00 | none |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | refunded | refunded to the estate | $1.00 | none |
| VGLI $200,000 Coverage | refunded | refunded to the estate | $1.00 | none |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | refunded | refunded to the estate | $1.00 | none |
| VGLI $400,000 Coverage | refunded | refunded to the estate | $1.00 | none |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | refunded | refunded to the estate | $1.00 | none |

## The terms in words

- Premiums paid for coverage after the cancellation date are refunded.
- Premiums paid for months after the month of the insured's death are refunded to the estate.
- An overpaid premium of $1.00 or more is refunded; a smaller overpaid premium is credited forward rather than refunded.
- No interest is paid on a premium refund.

## Worked threshold (hypothetical amounts)

| Overpaid premium | Treatment |
|---|---|
| $0.99 | below $1.00: credited forward |
| $1.00 | at the $1.00 figure: refunded, without interest |
| $51.00 | above $1.00: refunded, without interest |
